anomalies.pada: Kŏ imaṁ paṭhaviṁ vicessati yamalokañ-ca imaṁ sadevakaṁ
Ko dhammapadaṁ sudesitaṁ kusalo puppham-ivappacessati
Sekho paṭhaviṁ vicessati yamalokañ-ca imaṁ sadevakaṁ
Sekho dhammapadaṁ sudesitaṁ kusalo puppham-ivappacessati
Yathā pi bhamaro pupphaṁ vaṇṇagandhaṁ aheṭhayaṁ paḷeti rasam-ādāya
Yathā saṅkāradhānasmiṁ ujjhitasmiṁ mahāpathe padumaṁ tattha jāyetha
andhabhūte puthujjane atirocati paññāya Sammāsambuddhasāvako
evam-etaṁ abhiññāya bhikkhu Buddhassa sāvako sakkāraṁ nābhinandeyya
Yaṁ kiñci yiṭṭhaṁ ca hutaṁ ca loke saṁvaccharaṁ yajetha puññapekkho
na vijjatī so jagatippadeso yatthaṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā
Yo daṇḍena adaṇḍesu appaduṭṭhesu dussati dasannam-aññataraṁ ṭhānaṁ khippam-eva nigacchati

Ahaṁ nāgo va saṅgāme cāpāto patitaṁ saraṁ ativākyaṁ titikkhissaṁ
